articles.title: Transformers and Rectifiers shares rally 30% in 2 sessions. What’s behind the sharp surge?
articles.summary: Shares of Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Ltd (TRIL) surged 11% to Rs 312 on December 15, marking a second consecutive day of gains. This impressive rally saw the company's stock climb 30% over the same period, indicating strong investor confidence in its market performance. This financial news reflects significant movement in the Indian stock market.
